digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified Gate / macOS pytest CI cell
propositions: macOS pytest cell runs full default suite plus integration tier, taking 2140-2486s vs 572-595s on Ubuntu for identical tests, becoming the critical path bottleneck (3.7x slower per-test due to process-spawn and git-store fixture overhead)

macOS platform-specific test behavior differences exist only in file locking (flock/fcntl/mkdir), atomic directory/rename, subprocess timeout (gtimeout vs timeout), and cross-process git contention; running full breadth on the slow runner adds latency without confidence gain

macOS cell must be reduced to platform_compat-marked subset of tests while Linux keeps full suite; marker application must be centralized in one auditable path-keyed location (tests/conftest.py) to prevent silent drift

platform_compat marker must be registered in pyproject.toml, auto-applied via _PLATFORM_COMPAT_PATH_FRAGMENTS path fragments in conftest.py, and macOS DEFAULT_SUITE_MARKS in _build-and-test.yml must select 'platform_compat and not external'
